note: CAD assembly animation and simulated operation of the fable-r2d2 package. Every printed piece is the delivered STL placed by scripts/assembly_layout.py. Purchased parts are nominal envelopes. Motion speeds are illustrative. Follow the assembly manual for wiring, torque, calibration and physical test gates.

chapters.name: title-card
chapters.title: Nine STL files. Twelve printed pieces.
chapters.instruction: R2-D2 | 317 mm body | three powered feet | six drive wheels per pair | Raspberry Pi 4 and KB2040 | 12 V 7 Ah battery
chapters.narration: Simulated assembly. Nine printed designs make twelve pieces.

chapters.name: feet
chapters.title: 01 | Three feet, six motors, twelve wheels
chapters.instruction: Load two Adafruit 3777 motors and four 3766 wheels into each foot through the sole, then fit the motor tab bolts. Right and centre feet are shown cut away.
chapters.narration: Each foot takes two T T motors and four wheels, loaded from the sole.

chapters.name: outer-legs
chapters.title: 02 | Outer legs, two prints each
chapters.instruction: Slide the lower leg tongue into the foot slot, splice the upper leg over it, run two M8 rods the full length, then fit the ankle pivot and lock bolts.
chapters.narration: Join each leg over two M8 rods, then bolt the ankle pivot and lock.

chapters.name: centre-leg-caster
chapters.title: 03 | Centre leg and caster
chapters.instruction: Press two bearings onto the centre-foot stem, drop the centre leg over them, fit the M12 caster bolt and the sixty degree stop pin. The foot then swivels freely.
chapters.narration: The centre foot swivels on two bearings and one M12 caster bolt.

chapters.name: body-lower
chapters.title: 04 | Lower ring, battery and power
chapters.instruction: Lower the body floor onto the centre-leg flange bolts. Strap the 12 V 7 Ah battery to its shelf, then fit the speaker, the charge port and the main switch.
chapters.narration: Bolt the lower ring to the centre leg. Strap the battery to its shelf.

chapters.name: body-upper
chapters.title: 05 | Upper ring and shoulders
chapters.instruction: Seat the upper ring. Set both shoulder index pins to the three-leg angle, then run the M12 shoulder bolts through the leg discs into the body bosses.
chapters.narration: Seat the upper ring. Index each shoulder, then fit the M12 shoulder bolts.

chapters.name: electronics-deck
chapters.title: 06 | Integral electronics deck
chapters.instruction: Mount the Raspberry Pi 4, the KB2040, four DRV8833 drivers, both regulators, the ADS1115 and the fuse blocks on the deck printed into the upper ring.
chapters.narration: Mount the Pi, the K B twenty forty, four motor drivers, regulators and fuses.

chapters.name: rings-joined
chapters.title: 07 | Join the two rings
chapters.instruction: The locating lip aligns the rings. Fit eight M4 seam bolts through the internal flange, then four M8 rods on radius 138 to clamp the whole stack.
chapters.narration: Eight seam bolts and four M8 rods clamp the two rings together.

chapters.name: head-drive
chapters.title: 08 | Head friction drive
chapters.instruction: Bolt the drive base under the top plate. Fit the seventh motor and its wheel on the pivoting arm, then the spring, the M5 adjuster and the thumb nut.
chapters.narration: A seventh motor turns the dome by friction under the top plate.

chapters.name: dome-electronics
chapters.title: 09 | Dome displays and lights
chapters.instruction: On the bench: the twelve-wire slip ring at the hub, the round TFT behind the radar eye, four logic matrices, two PSI jewels and three holoprojector LEDs.
chapters.narration: Fit the slip ring, the eye display, the logic matrices and the P S I jewels.

chapters.name: dome-seated
chapters.title: 10 | Lazy susan and dome
chapters.instruction: Screw the lazy susan to the top plate, lower the dome onto it, then tighten the thumb nut until the drive wheel presses the dome plate by 0.6 mm.
chapters.narration: Screw down the lazy susan, seat the dome, then tension the drive wheel.

chapters.name: power-on
chapters.title: 11 | Power on
chapters.instruction: Simulated: the logic displays, the holoprojectors and both PSI lights come up behind the dome cutouts, and the dome begins to rotate.
chapters.narration: Power on. Logic displays, holoprojectors and P S I lights.

chapters.name: drive-demo
chapters.title: 12 | Simulated drive
chapters.instruction: Forward 400 mm, a wide left arc with the centre foot castering to the path, stop, reverse 150 mm, stop, then nudge the dome left and right.
chapters.narration: Forward, a wide left arc, stop, reverse, then a dome nudge.

chapters.name: closing-card
chapters.title: Assembly complete | Prototype design
chapters.instruction: {HEIGHT} mm tall | 317 mm body | nine STL files | twelve printed pieces | physical fit, strength and driving tests are still required. See the assembly manual.
chapters.narration: Physical fit, strength and driving tests are still required.
